objective: Collect an honest direct baseline for the installed foundation. This protocol does not compare alternatives and does not qualify the foundation automatically.

suite.qualificationLimit: This suite is required regression evidence but is not a sealed holdout or sufficient by itself to qualify a foundation.

baselineRuntime.runtimeRule: Use the pinned isolated runtime and unchanged BF16 installed foundation for every baseline track. A fresh owner authorization is required before any live collection.

tracks.purpose: Direct persona-free deterministic baseline for the installed foundation.
Two recorded-seed repetitions to expose instability under direct chat sampling.

requiredEvidence: Pinned repository and revision, complete artifact manifest, byte counts and hashes
Exact image digest, package versions, tokenizer/chat-template hashes and server command
GPU identity, configured and observed context limit, parser settings and reasoning controls
Raw request and response for every planned sample, including errors and truncation
Objective checks, executable coding results in an isolated no-network sandbox, JSON/schema checks and native tool-call checks
Blind human review of every response with critical failures adjudicated
Per-category baseline results, latency and token/cost measurements
A signed hold, qualification, or rejection decision with all missing evidence visible

developmentGate.qualificationPolicy: Any missing, unsupported, unreviewed, or inconclusive required evidence yields hold, never qualification.

explicitNonClaims: No inference was performed while this protocol was migrated.
The previous smoke conversation is not a full baseline or qualification pass.
HTTP success, a model listing, nonempty text, or self-reported execution is not capability evidence.
Published development cases are not sealed holdouts.
This protocol does not authorize paid compute, model downloads, transcript upload, training, or foundation-weight changes.
